source.title: JRC reference data from experiments of on-board hydrogen tanks fast filling
source.institution: European Commission Joint Research Centre GasTeF

required_request_payload: rights-cleared pressure, mass-flow and inlet-temperature time series
tank type, internal volume, geometry and material metadata
thermocouple coordinates, channel names, calibration uncertainty and response time
filling protocol, initial/final pressure, APRR and pre-cooling state
case-level checksums and permission for derived validation metrics
claim_boundary: The JRC publication establishes that a substantial GasTeF database exists and documents its measurement context. The current public record does not expose the raw machine-readable cases, so no independent numerical validation claim is made from this route.
